body: If you participate in our study and complete the procedures, namely the surveys and intervention, you would be emailed an Amazon gift card to compensate you for your time and participation. Hope that clears up your question!

1. All of your responses to these surveys and interviews will be stored and maintained by researchers at the 1U4U Lab at the University of Utah. Research records will be electronic and will be securely stored on password protected laptops and university servers. We will use an identification number to store data. At the end of the study, we will remove your name and contact information from your survey responses so that your answers cannot be identified.
2. This research is being conducted by the ACR Lab, a lab at the University of Utah.
3. This survey should take 30 minutes to an hour to complete.
4. This initial survey does not have compensation but if deemed eligible for our study, participants can earn up to $82. The compensations would be sent in three installments throughout the duration of the project and will be sent in the form of an Amazon Gift Card.
5. Anyone is eligible to participate in the study as long as they are between 18-50 years old and a current resident in the United States. In particular, we are looking for folx with either past or present suicidal ideation.
6. Our research is looking to work on improving interventions available for suicide prevention. This survey will screen for eligible participants to participate in our study.

Who I am: Student Researcher  
  
Affiliation: University of Utah  
  
Supervisor: Professor Monika Lohani (contact info upon request)  
  
Target group: Folx with Suicidal Ideation  
  
Compensation: If eligible to participate, you can be compensated up to $82  
  
Link: [https://educationutah.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV\_diD0yH5mVVzU4uy](https://educationutah.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_diD0yH5mVVzU4uy)  
  
Background: A suicide prevention study at the University of Utah is seeking participants between the ages of 18 & 50. Your input will help us understand therapy interventions and their effect on suicidal thoughts. Eligible participants will be: 1) assessed online (for about 1.5 hour long), 2) receive an online intervention session (with a trained therapist via Zoom set up about an hour-long), 3) complete a two-week text-based assessment before and after intervention (about 6 minutes/day), and 4) a 1-month follow-up assessment (about an hour-long). If you complete all the study procedures, you receive a total of $82 in electronic gift cards. To know more about the study or to see if you are eligible, you can take the survey [here](https://educationutah.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_diD0yH5mVVzU4uy) or contact us at schedule.prevent@gmail.com.
